pressAwards.reviewsHeadline: Reviews from the Media and Critics

aboutShow.body:
Behind every successful mompreneur is the knowledge most mothers never learn.

"Mompreneurs" is a curated docuseries featuring mothers who have mastered business and wealth-building in the real world. They've often done it while managing e-commerce stores, real estate portfolios, coaching practices, product lines, and investment strategies.

These aren't corporate executives climbing someone else's ladder.

They are mothers and entrepreneurs who created their businesses. They found their own path to generating wealth and achieving financial freedom while still being present for their families.

Across each episode, mompreneurs break down their strategies, share their secrets, and teach practical business and financial wisdom that most mothers never learned.

Each episode is carefully produced with authenticity and intention. The entire series focuses on real experience, proven strategies, and the realities of building wealth as a mother in today's world.

This is entrepreneurship beyond theory. It's told and shared by the mothers who live it and have mastered it.

body2.text: "Mompreneurs" features experienced mothers who don't just talk about building businesses. They share how they've done it while raising their children, managing their households, and creating the life they wanted.
Your episode isn't framed as a self-promotional piece or highlight reel.

It's a structured conversation that reflects how you've built your business, what strategies worked, what lessons you learned, and what you can teach other mothers who want to follow in your footsteps and do the same.
Success as a mompreneur isn't about having it all figured out...
It's about results, resilience, and the ability to show other mothers what's possible when you refuse to choose between your dreams and your family.

When your story is placed within a carefully curated series of mompreneurs operating at a high level, it reinforces what audiences are looking for. They're craving the real experience, proven strategies, and credibility that mothers like you deeply know.
This isn't an invitation to just self-promote.

It's an opportunity to be positioned as the kind of mompreneur serious mothers want to learn from and others want to associate with. By doing so, you quickly gain authority and credibility with your audience.

bodyTop: While the critics said it couldn't be done, you proved them wrong.
You didn't choose between career and family. You created both.
For years, you've been building something extraordinary — starting businesses between school drop-offs, closing deals during naptime, and growing your empire while raising your children.
You're living proof that mothers can build wealth, scale businesses, and create financial freedom on their own terms without their children or families paying the price.
You didn't just read about entrepreneurship. You lived it — client by client, launch by launch, investment by investment, all while being fully present for your family.
realityPoints: Millions of mothers are stuck in jobs that drain them...
Being told they have to choose between career success or being there for their kids...
With no roadmap for building wealth while raising a family.
Just as bad, the loudest voices in the mompreneur space are often those with the least amount of real results.
bodyMid: This is a curated television series designed to feature mothers who have actually done it. We're talking about the moms who have built real businesses, generated real wealth, and created real financial freedom…
All while being active and present for their families.
Our mission is simple: To showcase mothers like you who have mastered both business and motherhood and can inspire others to do the same.
Imagine a professionally produced feature that captures your journey, your strategies, and your secrets to building wealth as a mom.

aboutNetwork.subheadline: We unite entertainment, brands + visionary creators to share compelling stories
aboutNetwork.body:
At Inside Success, we believe that storytelling through TV is one of the most powerful ways to inspire real change and leave a lasting impact. Every original production is crafted to spotlight essential causes and spark meaningful conversations, drawing in millions to participate, support, and take action.

As the creative force behind today's thriving brands, we turn entrepreneurs into industry icons. Inside Success believes every entrepreneur has a unique story to share.

Our mission is to channel our passion and expertise to amplify your voice, giving your brand the recognition it deserves and positioning you as a go-to authority. We'll work with you to bring your vision to life, transforming it into an inspiration for audiences around the world.

items.question: How long will it take for my episode to be produced?
items.answer: Producing high-quality television takes time to deliver the impact your story deserves. The full process, from filming to editing and strategic release, typically takes between 6 to 12 months. This ensures your episode is polished, professionally edited, and launched alongside other successful mompreneurs in the series.

items.question: What if I'm not comfortable on camera?
items.answer:
You don't need to be a media professional to look like one. We've guided countless mompreneurs, experts, and first-time guests through natural, conversational interviews that bring out their confidence and authenticity.
Our production team makes the process simple, supportive, and stress-free — so you shine on screen.

items.question: What about childcare during filming?
items.answer: We understand that arranging childcare is part of your planning. Our Miami studio filming is typically completed in one intensive day, making it easier to coordinate someone else to care for your children while you are filming. Many mompreneurs choose to make it a family trip to Miami and arrange local childcare for the filming day.

items.question: How will my episode be promoted?
items.answer:
Your episode will be featured on major streaming platforms and supported by a professional press release distributed to over 100 media networks. You'll also receive tailored social media content to expand your visibility and reach.

"Mompreneurs" features some of the nation's most successful mothers in business. On this show, these mothers and business owners are presented on their episodes.

All episodes are promoted or cross-promoted throughout the season. This ensures your story is seen by thousands, if not millions, of engaged viewers.

items.question: How long will my episode be?
items.answer: The final runtime will be determined in post-production. But most episodes range between 15 and 30 minutes. This allows your story and journey to be told in a dynamic, high-impact format.

items.title: 1. Credibility of the Platform
items.body: Major streaming platforms aren't just about reach—they're about prestige, authority, and influence. When your episode airs on the same platforms that showcase top CEOs, elite entrepreneurs, and high-level experts, you gain instant validation. Your name will be positioned among the most credible voices in the industry, giving you the kind of brand authority that separates people like you from the rest.

items.title: 2. Value vs. Cost
items.body: This is an investment in your legacy. The exposure alone is worth far more than the cost, but the real power comes from what you do with it. Imagine the ROI when this feature helps you close high-ticket deals, land major speaking opportunities, or secure brand partnerships that multiply your revenue. Time and time again, we've seen people turn a single TV episode into a game-changing moment for their business and brand.

items.title: 3. Time Commitment and Process
items.body: We know you are busy, which is why we handle everything—from scheduling and filming to editing and distribution. All filming takes place at our Miami location, where we manage all technical details to ensure a seamless experience. Our 6–12 month production timeline ensures every episode meets the highest standards, giving your story the polished, professional showcase it deserves.

items.title: 4. Quality Assurance
items.body: Your episode isn't just another piece of content—it's a high-end production designed to match the standards of top-tier media and A-list brands. Our team has worked with some of the biggest names in business, sports, and entertainment, ensuring that every frame, every soundbite, and every edit reflects excellence and credibility. This isn't amateur video content—it's a broadcast-quality asset that cements your authority.

items.title: 5. Comfort and Camera Presence
items.body: No worries—we've got you covered. Rudy Mawer has interviewed countless individuals, and he knows how to make people feel at ease. You'll receive coaching and guidance throughout the process to ensure you feel comfortable and confident. We'll walk you through the entire interview, helping you highlight your strengths and tell your story in the most engaging way possible. Our goal is to bring out the best version of you on camera.

items.title: 6. Exclusivity and Differentiation
items.body: This isn't your typical TV spot or podcast appearance. This is a fully dedicated, professionally produced episode—crafted around your story and your brand. You have the power to control the narrative, and it's presented in a way that sets you apart from the competition. Plus, you'll be featured alongside MAJOR names—athletes, celebrities, and business icons—leveraging the power of association to instantly boost your status and credibility.

items.title: 7. Results Beyond Exposure
items.body: Exposure is just the start—the real impact comes from the doors this opens. TV appearances have been proven to drive real business growth, from higher conversion rates and premium pricing power to massive demand for high-ticket offers. Many of our past features have turned their episodes into lead-generating machines, using their appearance to secure partnerships, new clients, and media attention that keep delivering ROI long after the show airs.

items.title: 8. Long-Term Impact and Opportunities
items.body: Your episode isn't just a one-time event—it's a permanent, high-value asset that continues working for you for years. Once it's released, it becomes a trusted authority piece that gets you booked for podcasts, speaking gigs, and media appearances. The credibility boost alone can transform your business, helping you land bigger deals, grow your brand, and establish yourself as an industry leader for the long haul.

items.title: 9. Legitimacy and Vetting Process
items.body: This isn't just about filling slots—we're curating a world-class series featuring the best of the best. Every applicant goes through a strict vetting process, ensuring that only high-caliber entrepreneurs, leaders, and experts make the cut. If accepted, you'll be part of an elite group of professionals, standing alongside some of the most respected names in business, sports, and innovation, reinforcing both your credibility and the show's prestige.
